mainText: Hello, Verona! At 9 AM, the temperature is 78 degrees with clear skies over Fireman's Park and a full moon shining tonight.

The intersection of Nine Mound Road and Mark Drive will be closed August 5 through 7 for sewer work. Also, please join the virtual meeting on August 6 to see the final design for our new city skatepark.

Today, enjoy Yoga at Insight Wellness, a free concert at Century School Park, or trivia at Hop Haus. Looking ahead, we have live music at Bailey's Run and Lake Lou-ee tomorrow, plus the Farmer's Market on Saturday.
On July 25, a 29-year-old woman was arrested for her first O W I offence.

Today's delicious flavor is Caramel Turtle, and you can find the Kona Ice truck at Fireman's Park today from 12:30 to 4:30 PM. The shop opens at 10 AM, but if you miss out, tomorrow's flavor is Raspberry Cheesecake.
